overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried green banana powder from selected unripe bananas sourced in India. Produced through controlled drying and precise processing, this fine carbohydrate ingredient offers consistent granulation and low moisture. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain batch traceability and disciplined quality inspections to support industrial food formulations.

Our unripe banana powder delivers reliable functional performance across diverse dry mixes, bakery goods, and beverage systems. We provide flexible supply solutions including wholesale bulk containers, tailored mesh sizing, and private label packaging. With dedicated export documentation support and small trial minimums, we serve global distributors, brands, and commercial manufacturing facilities.
applications: Bakery formulations and gluten-free flour blends
Soups, gravies, and culinary sauce thickeners
Snack bar and confectionery functional fillers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating pilot testing as well as commercial-scale bulk container shipments.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples prior to order placement?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with formulation development and evaluation.

faqs.q: Can you accommodate custom mesh sizes and packaging formats?
faqs.a: We provide custom grinding, sieving, and private-label packaging options, including branded pouches, jars, and bulk containers.

faqs.q: What manufacturing process is utilized for this ingredient?
faqs.a: We follow a 6-step manufacturing process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: What documentation is provided for international shipments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support, technical data sheets, and shipment paperwork for international clearance.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions and shelf life?
faqs.a: When stored in a cool, dry place away from direct moisture, the powder maintains a shelf life of 18 to 24 months.
